name: Life expectancy at birth

anchors.source: U.S. life expectancy at birth dipped to ~76.4 in 2021 and has sat between 76 and 79 since 2000. L=74 anchors below the pandemic trough as a stressed-domestic floor; U=84 anchors near the top-of-OECD ceiling (Japan, Switzerland ~84).
